status: Ordered fallback projection uses batch-scoped admission and owned collection; broader audit remains open
contract: Ordinary and ordered fallback producers share appendProjectedOutput. Exact retained ordered rows reuse their owner; changed projections detach selected fields and preserve known immutable projection allocations.
Ordered projection uses per-row scratch and per-output-batch ownership. Advancing or closing a borrowed stream releases projection scratch without releasing retained sorting input prematurely.
Ordered fallback toOwnedArray and toArray use the existing owned collector. Vector top-k fast paths remain ahead of fallback collection.

cases: Exact measured peak succeeds and cap-minus-one rejects for ordinary, ordered sort and ordered top-k owned projection.
Ordered full-sort and top-k streaming batch advance holds stable reservations; early return preserves sibling ownership and releases query allocations.
Real Brotli Parquet fixture projections now include ordered collection in HTTP 206, ignored-Range 200, and native local Worker R2 tests at 64/128 MiB shared pool sizes.

limits: No throughput improvement claimed. Selected mutable data detachment adds work.
DISTINCT, hive, windows, borrowed references, partition merging, source input allocations and remaining scalar internals still need their complete ownership contracts.
Reservation bounds are not a total Worker heap or production Cloudflare memory certification.
The entire release checklist is still open; older release gate results must not be attributed to this revision.
